description: Report a defect in Morpha itself to the Morpha team: a tool that errors when it should not, a result that contradicts the documentation, or a render that does not match what describe_video says. Not for your own mistakes (a wrong id, a bad argument the error already explained) and not for feature requests. Describe what you called, with its arguments, what came back, and what you expected; include the tool name and the exact error text. Pass projectId when the problem is in a project, so the team can open it. API keys, bearer tokens and email addresses are removed from the description before it is stored. The team replies by email to the account's address, never through this tool. Returns { reportId, message }. Limited to 10 reports an hour per account.

description.description: What went wrong: the tool call and its arguments, the result or error text, and what you expected instead. 1 to 4,000 characters.

projectId.description: Optional. The project the problem shows up in; you need at least view access to it.
